name: Titus
source:
A four-armed samurai, Titus carries the grimoire Cultes des Goules (屍食教典儀 Shishokukyō Tengi) and takes to the field of battle in the Deus Machina Ogre.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Demonbane_characters#Anticross]Wikipedia[/url].]

[spoiler]In [url=https://vndb.org/v234]Kishin Hishou Demonbane[/url], Titus and the rest of Anticross from [url=https://vndb.org/v231]Zanma Taisei/Kishin Houkou[/url] were brought back by [url=https://vndb.org/c12696]Another Blood[/url] as nightmare for her "story". The real Titus as well as entire Anticross and Black Lodge has been erased from history, after the events of Al Azif's route.[/spoiler]
